info.title: How Community works
info.step1: Claim a tile on the shared canvas
info.step2: Draw your piece from the day's picture
info.step3: Fill the canvas — it expands as tiles are completed
info.footer: One tile per canvas. No digital tools. No AI. Just paper, a pen, and you.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accessibility_hint: Legible font, system cursor, no motion or sounds.

landing.title: Community
landing.description: Grab a piece of paper and something to draw with — a pen, pencil, crayon, whatever you've got. Here you'll team up with people from around the world to create one drawing together. Ready? Let's make something awesome.

game.claim_tile: Tap a tile to claim it
game.masterpiece_complete_body: That's a wrap on today's picture. Come back for the next one.

claim.error: Could not claim tile. Please try again.

preview.title: Preview
preview.intro: You've got 10 minutes to draw your piece — grab your paper and pen and let's go.

idle.title: Still drawing?
idle.body: Tap to keep your tile — it'll free up in {{count}}s otherwise.

upload.title: Upload your drawing
upload.hint: Draw this tile, then upload a photo
upload.scan_qr_hint: Opens the camera on your phone
upload.confirm_release_body: Your spot will go back to the pool and someone else can grab it.

perspective.title: Adjust corners
perspective.hint: Drag each corner to outline the edges of your drawing.

phase.advance_subtitle: The grid is now subdividing into phase {{phase}}
phase.completed_subtitle: Every tile has been drawn. Amazing work, everyone!
phase.current_aria: Phase {{phase}}, {{phaseGridSize}} by {{phaseGridSize}} unlocked out of {{finalGridSize}} by {{finalGridSize}}

archive.title: Museum
archive.subtitle: The permanent collection
archive.tap_hint: Tap a day to see all the drawings
archive.no_draws_yet: No draws composed yet for this day
archive.gallery_hint: Tap a piece to see how it came to life

admin.title: Admin Panel
admin.subtitle: Debug tools for development
admin.upload_image_hint: Select a JPG image to set as today's daily image
admin.create_period_hint: Creates an active period from the current daily image
admin.reset_period_hint: Resets to phase 1: clears all claims, submissions, and tiles
admin.delete_period_hint: Permanently deletes the active period and all its data
admin.draw_all_hint: Marks all tiles as drawn — triggers phase completion
admin.confirm_delete: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
admin.confirm_draw_all: This will complete the current phase. Continue?

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.subtitle: Let us know what you think — no account needed
